---
title: "Standardfehler des Mittelwerts"
params:
  lang: "de"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

task <- "onesamplet2"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

hook(s_X, subscript(s, X))
hook(n, N)

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n <- sample(10:20, 1)
  s_X <- round(runif(1, min = 6, max = 12), 1)

  Q <- quote(search(onesamplet2, tratio(s_X, n),
    .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$bugs, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
```

Question
========
Wir betrachten eine Stichprobe mit $N=`r n`$ Beobachtungen und einer empirischen Standardabweichung von $s_X=`r s_X`$. 
Bestimme den Standardfehler des Mittelwerts.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
Der Standardfehler des Mittelwerts wird folgendermaßen berechnet: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```

Meta-information
================
extype: schoice
exsolution: `r mchoice2string(t$correct, single=TRUE)`
exname: onesamplet2
